tools.name: geoscience_collection_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a directory or collection of NetCDF and GeoTIFF files and report formats, variables, dimensions, time ranges, CRS, bounds and resolutions.

tools.name: geoscience_coordinate_normalize
tools.description: Normalize CF coordinate names, longitude from 0-360 to -180-180, and latitude/longitude ordering in a NetCDF artifact.

tools.name: geoscience_grid_compare
tools.description: Compare the spatial grid, CRS, dimensions and coordinate endpoints of multiple NetCDF or GeoTIFF files before cross-file analysis.

tools.name: geoscience_quality_check
tools.description: Check missing values, valid ranges, units, dimensions and basic data quality indicators for a NetCDF or GeoTIFF file.

tools.name: geoscience_unit_convert
tools.description: Convert a supported physical unit in a NetCDF variable and write a new artifact, preserving metadata.

tools.name: geoscience_raster_stack
tools.description: Stack multiple aligned GeoTIFF scenes as bands in one raster artifact.

tools.name: geoscience_raster_mosaic
tools.description: Mosaic adjacent GeoTIFF scenes into one spatially continuous raster while retaining the first scene profile.

tools.name: geoscience_sample_raster
tools.description: Sample one or more coordinate points from a GeoTIFF and return band values with CRS context.

tools.name: geoscience_qa_mask
tools.description: Apply a selected quality-assurance bit mask to a raster and write an invalid-pixel-masked GeoTIFF.

tools.name: geoscience_scene_composite
tools.description: Create a median composite from multiple aligned GeoTIFF scenes, suitable for cloud-reduced multi-temporal imagery.

tools.name: geoscience_climatology
tools.description: Compute monthly climatology from a multi-file NetCDF time series and write a NetCDF artifact.

tools.name: geoscience_anomaly
tools.description: Compute monthly anomalies against the multi-file NetCDF monthly climatology.

tools.name: geoscience_trend
tools.description: Estimate a bounded linear temporal trend from a multi-file NetCDF time series.

tools.name: geoscience_artifact_validate
tools.description: Validate that a generated NetCDF, GeoTIFF or other artifact exists, is non-empty and can be opened.

tools.name: geoscience_vector_inspect
tools.description: Inspect vector data such as Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage or GeoParquet and report geometry, CRS, bounds and attributes.

tools.name: geoscience_vector_transform
tools.description: Reproject, remove empty geometries and repair invalid geometries in vector data, writing GeoJSON output.

tools.name: geoscience_zonal_statistics
tools.description: Compute count, mean, minimum and maximum raster values for every polygon in a vector layer.

tools.name: geoscience_rasterize_vector
tools.description: Rasterize vector geometries onto the grid and CRS of a reference GeoTIFF.

tools.name: geoscience_grid_align
tools.description: Reproject and resample a GeoTIFF onto the exact CRS, transform, width and height of a reference GeoTIFF.

tools.name: geoscience_remote_product_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a remote-sensing GeoTIFF for platform hints, band descriptions, units and embedded product metadata before applying product-specific operations.

tools.name: geoscience_change_detection
tools.description: Calculate an after-minus-before difference raster and summary statistics from two grid-aligned GeoTIFF scenes.

tools.name: geoscience_spatial_join
tools.description: Join two vector layers using an explicit spatial predicate and write a GeoJSON artifact.

tools.name: geoscience_transect_profile
tools.description: Sample a raster along a polyline and return distances, coordinates and values for a terrain or environmental transect.
